graph.name: Draft a shorter reply
graph.description:
Propose a shorter version of the reply for review, using a supplied concise-writing reference.

Lesson: A reference requests approximate brevity; maxTokens caps the auxiliary completion, not final word count.

Limitations: Length is requested from the model, not enforced as an exact word count. Meaning still needs review.

Opening makes this example the active workflow document. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Request light trimming instead of roughly one-third fewer words and compare retained actions.
Protect slowly turned the handle and see where remaining compression occurs.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Before: After taking a moment to look at the door, she reached out her hand and slowly turned the handle.

After: She studied the door, then slowly turned the handle.

Concise path: reply.out → tighten.in; brief.out → tighten.reference; tighten → validate → review → apply. One Prose call.

Two budgets: Word reduction is Compose text; maxTokens is the actual completion cap. No targetLength/reductionPercent control exists.

Door action · verbose source (reply)
Purpose: Freeze the latest completed text-only verbose door reply.
Fixture: After taking a moment to look at the door, she reached out her hand and slowly turned the handle. She waited for the latch to click.
Inspect: Observe door → slowly turn handle → wait; latch has not clicked.

Keep verbs, trim setup (brief)
Purpose: Supply concise rhythm and preserved actions.
Inspect: The crossing sample teaches compression only.

Tighten action rhythm (tighten)
Purpose: Trim setup without losing the action sequence.
Inspect: Check all three actions and protected slowly/latch.

Output tokens includes visible text and any reasoning tokens counted by the provider. A truncated result is discarded; inspect the error, then manually raise the cap and rerun. No automatic retry occurs.

Check concise-action patches (validate)
Purpose: Validate concise-action patches.
Inspect: Check protected words and source-bound replacements.

Review the three-action sequence (review)
Purpose: Require a three-action comparison.
Inspect: Reject omitted observation, faster turning or a completed click.

Offer concise door prose (apply)
Purpose: Offer concise door prose.
Inspect: Full root Host result: check sequence, then Apply or Reject.

sections.name: Aim
sections.text: Request roughly one-third fewer words by trimming action scaffolding. Keep meaningful speed, hesitation and unfinished outcomes.

sections.name: Sample
sections.text: Original specimen: Before making her way across the room, she took a look at the floor. / She checked the floor before crossing.

sections.name: MustKeep
sections.text: Retain door observation, slow handle turn and wait for latch, in order. Do not open the door or make the latch click.

tighten.title: Style Transfer
tighten.instructions: Trim scaffolding and duplication. Retain door observation, slow turn, wait, sequence and unresolved latch. Aim for rough reduction; never force a count or imply the door opens.
